newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Swelling investor demand slows Venezuela CVG sale.
newsitem.headline: Swelling investor demand slows Venezuela CVG sale.

text.p: Swelling investor demand has delayed the sale of the aluminium and iron companies in Venezuela's Corporacion Venezolana de Guyana (CVG) industrial complex until early 1997, leading daily El Universal reported.
"There's been greater interest in the companies than we had previously expected," Venezuela Investment Fund President Alberto Poletto told a Venezuelan/Japanese business group, the paper reported.
"Processing that extra demand will take an extra four weeks," he said. The sale is now scheduled for January rather than December.

Thirteen companies have prequalified for the sale of the aluminium companies Alcasa, Venalum, Bauxilium and Carbonorca, Poletto said, and another eleven for the iron and steel companies Sidor and Fesilven.
